dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thin white horizontal band clearly visible across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale grey/white margins on dark grey-blue flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Bright white, sub-triangular patch located on the posterior neck between the crown and mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, linear boundary separating the black crown from the olive-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white facial patch completely bordered by black plumage on the crown and throat.
